privacy.intro: At Aikrofy, we take your privacy seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information according to international standards and platform requirements such as Google Cloud Console.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.content: To provide our AI-powered assistant services, we collect information you provide directly to us when creating an account, connecting messaging channels (WhatsApp, Telegram), or integrating Google Services.
collection.item1: Account Data: Name, email, business name, and password.
collection.item2: Integration Data: OAuth tokens for Google Calendar, Gmail, and messaging API keys.
collection.item3: Interaction Data: Conversations between your business and your leads handled by our AI agents.

google.title: 2. Google User Data (Limited Use Policy)
google.content: Aikrofy requests access to your Google Calendar and Gmail to enable your AI agents to schedule appointments and send emails on your behalf.
google.disclosure: Aikrofy's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to Google API Service User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
use.content: We use the collected data to:
use.item1: Provide and maintain the Aikrofy platform services.
use.item2: Enable your AI agents to answer customer queries accurately using your knowledge base.
use.item3: Automate scheduling in your Google Calendar and send emails via your Gmail integration.
use.item4: Improve our AI models and system performance.

sovereignty.title: 4. Data Sovereignty & Security
sovereignty.content: Aikrofy follows a Data Sovereignty principle. Your business data is isolated and encrypted. We do not share your customer leads or conversation history with third parties for marketing purposes.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our service integrates with third-party providers such as Google (OAuth), WhatsApp (via Gateway), and PayPal. Your interactions with these services are governed by their respective privacy policies.

contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at hello@aikrofy.com

terms.intro: By using Aikrofy, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using Aikrofy ('the Platform'), you consent to comply with these terms. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Platform.

service.title: 2. Description of Service
service.content: Aikrofy is an AI-powered SaaS ecosystem for business automation. It allows businesses to deploy virtual agents for customer capture, scheduling, and support via messaging channels.

responsibility.title: 3. AI Agent & Responsible Use
responsibility.content: You agree to use your AI agent and its capabilities for lawful purposes only. You are responsible for:
responsibility.item1: The information you provide to your AI agent for training (knowledge base).
responsibility.item2: The conversations initiated by your AI agent with leads.
responsibility.item3: Ensuring you do not use the AI agent for spam, harassment, or illegal activities.

payments.title: 4. Payments & Subscriptions
payments.content: Access to Platform capabilities requires an active subscription. Payments are securely processed via PayPal. Subscriptions are billed periodically and can be managed from your Billing panel.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: The Platform provides AI-generated responses. While we strive for accuracy, Aikrofy is not liable for errors, hallucinations, or omissions in agent conversations. It is your responsibility to review and correct agent behavior.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.p1: At Aikrofy, we want to ensure full satisfaction with our AI agent service. Due to the real-time consumption of credits from AI model inference and associated services, our refund policy is governed by the following conditions.

section1.title: 1. Monthly and Annual Subscriptions
section1.p1: We offer a 14-day refund guarantee from the purchase date of any of our plans (Jab, Uppercut, Knockout), subject to the following consumption rules:
section1.li1: A 100% refund applies if your account's accumulated conversation credit consumption is less than 10% of the monthly credits included in your contracted plan.
section1.li2: If you have consumed more than 10% of your monthly credits within the 14-day period, no full refunds will be applied due to the costs already incurred for AI API processing.

section2.title: 2. Credit Top-up Packages
section2.p1: Additional conversation credit top-up packages are non-refundable once consumption has started. If you purchased a top-up package by error and have not consumed any credits from it, you can request a full refund within 7 days of purchase.

section3.title: 3. Refund Processing (PayPal)
section3.p1: All our payments and subscriptions are managed securely through PayPal.
section3.p2: Once a refund request is approved, it will be processed automatically through PayPal and funds will be returned to your original payment method (credit/debit card or PayPal account) within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank.

section4.title: 4. How to Request a Refund
section4.p1: To request a cancellation and refund of your subscription, please contact our support team at hello@aikrofy.com, including:
section4.li1: The email address associated with your Aikrofy account.
section4.li2: The transaction ID or PayPal subscription ID.
section4.li3: A brief description of why you are requesting a refund (this helps us improve our product).

refunds.footer: If you have questions about our policies or credit consumption for AI model inference and associated costs, write us at hello@aikrofy.com. We are here to help.
